ABOUT
關於 Museum

StarRiver Museum 是一項持續發展中的數位策展與創作計畫。

我們希望用展覽、文字、互動體驗與虛擬空間，組織不同形式的作品、觀察與故事。從創作筆記到文化與社群記錄，內容隨實際發表逐步累積。

觀看公開展示
→
目前階段
網站可參觀；虛擬館舍持續規劃

目前已有可進入的網頁展示。獨立 VR 館舍仍在規劃，並未以完整開館的狀態對外宣告。

網站與館舍
入口不等於建築

Museum 網站是策展與內容入口；虛擬館舍是其中一種空間體驗。展覽可以在網頁、獨立小站、VRChat 世界或其他媒介發生，不必先進入同一棟建築。

呈現方式
作品、內容與空間

除了作品展示，這裡也可以容納文化文章、社群記錄、創作筆記、研究與互動體驗。不同內容會依實際發表情形逐步建立入口，不預先假設固定展期或作品數量。

聯絡與合作詢問
→

ABOUT
About Museum

StarRiver Museum is an evolving digital curation and creative project.

Through exhibitions, writing, interactive experiences, and virtual spaces, Museum brings together works, observations, and stories. Creative notes, cultural writing, and community accounts can grow with each publication.

EXPLORE AVAILABLE DISPLAYS
→
CURRENT STAGE
Public web displays; venue in development

Browser-accessible displays are available now. A separate VR venue remains in development and is not presented as fully open.

SITE AND VENUE
The site is not the building

The Museum website is a curatorial entry point; the virtual venue is one possible spatial experience. Exhibitions may live on the web, in standalone sites, in VRChat worlds, or in other media.

WHAT BELONGS HERE
Works, writing, and spaces

Alongside artworks, Museum can host cultural writing, community accounts, creative notes, research, and interactive experiences. Pages will follow actual published content rather than a pre-set schedule or quota.

CONTACT & COLLABORATION
→
© 2026 STARRIVER ARTSSTARRIVER MUSEUM

Planned and produced by StarRiver Arts, with OpenAI GPT and Anthropic Claude used to assist information architecture and web development.

Gallery Study Modules

This page gathers two interactive modules related to VR Gallery Spatial System, helping visitors understand virtual gallery viewing through spatial layout and changes in light.

VIEWING MODE

A desktop browser is recommended. The planner and falloff tool use fixed-width workspaces; mobile layouts are not yet available. Their bilingual labels do not follow this page’s language switch.

SCALE AND LIGHTING STUDIES

Gallery Spatial Planner

A plan-and-elevation gallery layout module for understanding the relationship between wall placement, reserve volumes, viewing direction, and circulation clearance.

LAYOUT

Light Falloff Viewer

A module for understanding how falloff models, surface colours, and distance shape illumination, colour drift, and the feeling of viewing in a gallery.

TAIWAN TOUGE PROJECT
ProjectT

臺灣山道計畫

自臺灣公路地景出發，連結世界、社群、紀錄與賽事工具的 VRChat 賽車社群計畫。

VRRCTW
參加活動
PROJECTT 生態
世界、社群、資料與工具

ProjectT 包含 VRChat 世界、中文賽車社群、計時與賽事資料，以及活動工具。玩家可以在這裡找到世界、參與活動、查詢紀錄，並了解社群、賽道與賽事的發展。

WORLDS
ProjectT Worlds

由 StarRiver 製作的 VRChat 臺灣地景世界。這些場景從臺灣公路文化與自然地景出發，提供駕駛、探索、聚會、車輛測試與活動空間。

查看世界
COMMUNITY
VRRCTW

中文圈主要的 VRChat 賽車社群，連結玩家、世界創作者、車輛作者與活動組織者，持續舉辦駕駛聚會、計時挑戰與賽事。

進入社群
DATA & RECORDS
Racing Hub 賽事中心

整理 VRChat 賽車世界、路線、玩家、車輛、活動與計時紀錄的資料及資訊系統。你可以從這裡查詢 Time Attack、世界資料與活動結果。

開啟 RACING HUB 賽事中心
內部使用／開發中
VRChat Racing Toolkit

協助活動組織者設定賽事、整理結果並串接 Racing 的工具組。計時榜資料串接等部分核心流程已投入內部使用，完整的公開操作介面、發布板與資料整合仍在開發中。

PROJECTT WORLDS
從觀星山開始

探索由 StarRiver 製作並納入 ProjectT 的世界；下列為已公開的作品介紹。

StarSight Mt. 觀星山

在虛構的臺灣山道一路急馳向下，亦可在 VRRCTW 聚會據點停留。已公開，PC + Quest。

作品介紹
九彎十八拐

臺 9 線石牌至頭城段的宜蘭公路地景。已公開，PC + Quest；重製規劃中。

作品介紹

玉長公路與武嶺仍為封閉測試，尚無正式公開入口。

文章與賽車知識
Articles

Articles 收錄世界與路線介紹、使用指南、玩家觀點、社群故事、賽事紀錄與開發內容。文章提供資料頁與排行榜無法完整呈現的背景、經驗與評論。

指南、評論與社群、活動與賽事、ProjectT 開發；文章目錄尚未公開。

A VRChat racing community project connecting worlds, community, records, and competition tools from the roads and landscapes of Taiwan.

VRRCTW
Join Events
PROJECTT ECOSYSTEM
Worlds, community, data, and tools

ProjectT brings together VRChat worlds, a Chinese-language racing community, timing and event data, and competition tools. Find worlds, join activities, explore records, and follow the development of the community and its racing culture.

WORLDS
ProjectT Worlds

VRChat Taiwan landscape worlds created by StarRiver for driving, exploration, gatherings, vehicle testing, and events.

EXPLORE WORLDS
COMMUNITY
VRRCTW

A leading Chinese-language VRChat racing community connecting players, world creators, vehicle creators, and event organizers.

ENTER COMMUNITY
DATA & RECORDS
Racing Hub

A structured information system for VRChat racing worlds, routes, players, vehicles, events, and Time Attack records.

OPEN RACING HUB
INTERNAL USE / IN DEVELOPMENT
VRChat Racing Toolkit

A competition toolset for event setup, result processing, and Racing integration. Core timing-data workflows are in internal use while the public interface remains in development.

PROJECTT WORLDS
Start with StarSight Mt.

Explore worlds created by StarRiver and included in ProjectT. These portfolio pages introduce currently public works.

StarSight Mt.

Drive downhill through a fictional Taiwanese mountain road and stop by the VRRCTW gathering place. Public on PC + Quest.

VIEW PROJECT
9 Turns

A Yilan road landscape based on Highway 9 from Shipai to Toucheng. Public on PC + Quest; a rebuild is planned.

VIEW PROJECT

Yuli–Changbin and Wuling remain in closed testing without public entry links.

CONTENT & KNOWLEDGE
Articles

Articles cover worlds and routes, guides, player viewpoints, community stories, event records, and development—context that data pages and leaderboards cannot provide alone.

Guides, Reviews & Community, Events, and ProjectT Development. The article catalogue is not yet public.
